title: UPPSC Combined State Upper Subordinate Services Exam, ACF, RFO Exam 2025 : ACF / RFO Mains Result 2026
postName: UPPSC Combined State Upper Subordinate Services / ACF / RFO Mains Result 2026
vacancyDetails: UPPSC Combined State Upper Subordinate Services 2025 and ACF/RFO mains result 2026 for combined upper subordinate and forest services posts.
qualification: Bachelor's degree in any discipline or specific subject-wise eligibility for ACF/RFO as per UPPSC rules and notification.

shortDescription: UPPSC Combined State Upper Subordinate Services Exam, ACF and RFO Mains Result 2026 is available. Check the official UPPSC result PDF and download the mains result notice.
content:
Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission (UPPSC) has released the ACF / RFO Mains Result 2026 for the Combined State/Upper Subordinate Services Examination 2025.

Candidates who appeared in the mains exam can now access the official result PDF and check their qualifying status for the next stages. The result includes ACF and RFO-related mains information as per the official UPPSC notification.

Applicants should visit the UPPSC official portal to search their roll number and follow any further interview or document verification instructions.
